rows.source_title: Piezoelectric laminate and piezoelectric element
rows.source_abstract: The invention provides a piezoelectric laminate and a piezoelectric element, which have higher withstand voltage and higher reliability than the prior art. The piezoelectric laminate and the piezoelectric element are provided with a lower electrode layer and a piezoelectric film containing a perovskite oxide as a main component in this order on a substrate, and when an upper electrode layer is formed on the piezoelectric film and a voltage applied between the upper electrode layer and the lower electrode layer is scanned, and when the lower electrode layer is grounded, the upper electrode layer is used as a driving electrode, and after the voltage applied to the piezoelectric film is gradually increased from 0V to the positive side, the number of peaks at the time of voltage increase is different from the number of peaks at the time of voltage decrease in a current-voltage curve indicating a change in current versus a change in voltage obtained when the voltage gradually decreases from the positive side to the negative side.
